_comment: Event-group jackknife input for the dijet rho unfolding statistics: a separate nominal-only minimal_rho run on the pair_split fiducial (same files and running conditions as dijet_data_2017_minimal_rho_pairsplit.json, never run together with all_syst). jk_groups=100 fills the six rho unfolding hists once more into <name>_jkgroups copies, each event in one of 100 groups (splitmix64 hash of run, lumi, event); the unfolding forms the delete-one replicas as total - group. The processor forces nominal weights and jets whenever jk_groups is set. Output minimal_rho_dijet_data_jkg100_2017.pkl; copy it to the unfold inputs under inputs/dijet/rho/<tag>/jackknife/data/.
